physical_math.mirror_phi: abs(phi) = arccos(R/R0) tangent point in a flat-plane circular-geometry approximation; the Q1/Q4 source radii differ slightly
physical_math.toy_velocity: v0(R)+A(R)cos(2phi)+B(R)sin(2phi); only B* sin2phi identified by two mirror points, not A and v0 separately
physical_math.conditional_B: odd / sin(2*phi) if tangent geometry and exactly the stated m2 velocity ansatz
physical_math.conditional_centripetal_proxy: (vQ1^2-vQ4^2)/(R in meters), purely a circular-orbit proxy, NOT measured delta force

limitations: Only five deliberately selected prior Bound06 target radii; no new unselected H I population-level fit.
Q1 and Q4 gas curves do not measure a matched 3D location; inferred tangent-point circular speeds carry assumptions about circular orbits and solar motion.
No measurement uncertainty or covariance is supplied in the selected H I source tables, so a sign reversal cannot be assigned formal statistical significance here.
The effective B coefficient is conditional on a restrictive m=2 Fourier-velocity ansatz, not a measured Galactic bar mode.

m=2 potential is an illustrative scenario with epsilon=0.02, bar tilt 25 degrees and Gaussian-like radial envelope. It has not been fitted to either tracer family and is not a self-consistent stellar dynamics solution.
Bar rotating time evolution (pattern speed) and real spiral arms/perturbers are not solved.
At R=0, the Sgr A* Newtonian point-source field is undefined; no physical simulation of its interior.
At r>8.122kpc from GC, gas tangent-point mirror geometry is undefined in this simple Sun-based scheme and the CSV Q1/Q4 scenario fields are intentionally blank.
The mock quadrupole may alter the local solar radial force and should not be represented as still calibrated to 233km/s with nonzero epsilon.
No individual star gravity is allocated to any 729 station. The H I velocity comparisons cannot prove unique gravitational field components.
